title: Numerical invariants for three-generated ideals
summary: We study numerical invariants of homogeneous ideals generated by three forms, with particular emphasis on the interaction between the initial degree of the syzygy module, the multiplicity of the codimension-two part of the ideal, and the Bourbaki degree. We extend the Bourbaki degree from gradient ideals of plane curves to arbitrary three-generated homogeneous ideals and obtain sharp numerical bounds in both the general and the equigenerated settings.
